packageRules.description: Patch releases merge themselves once CI is green. They are the updates that arrive weekly and that nobody reads: reviewing them by hand trains the habit of clicking merge without looking, which is worse than not looking at all. minimumReleaseAge above still keeps a fresh release out of the repository for three days, and minor, major and digest updates are still merged by a human. Requesting a review on a pull request that merges itself would send exactly the notification this rule exists to avoid, so the reviewer set at the top level is cleared here.
